Ava - CSM: :wave: Quick check — BrightWave renewal call next Tue. They asked for confirmed uptime and latency SLOs + any historical credit exposure. Can ops confirm last 90d uptime and if any active credits? Also any onboarding gaps we should flag?
Ravi - Onboarding: I ran the onboarding checklist; their warmup didn't hit target cache TTLs for the first 2 weeks. Might affect cold-start latency. Notes: https://redwood.internal/onboard/brightwave
Sofia - Account Lead: We need to avoid surprises. If credit exposure > $5k we escalate. @Leo can you pull 90d availability and p50/p95 for their tenant?
Leo - SRE: pulling now. Preliminary: ~99.92% uptime for eu-west-1 over 90d, two partial-degradation incidents. p50 gen=120ms, p95 gen=420ms. Will post the exact queries.
OpsBot - metrics-bot: Query complete — uptime=99.918% (90d), incidents=2, total_downtime=16m, p50=118ms, p95=425ms. Results: https://graphs.internal/brightwave/uptime.csv :white_check_mark:
Ava - CSM: thanks. 99.918% vs their SLA 99.95% — looks like a breach. Can someone run the credit pro-rate calc? We should prepare a proposed amount and comms.
Sofia - Account Lead: Confirmed breach. Ravi — what's remediation ETA? We need a timeline for the renewal call.
Ravi - Onboarding: We've scheduled perf tuning and batching changes next week. ETA 7 days. Will include a post-mortem in the enablement session.
Leo - SRE: root cause: suboptimal batching config + cache warmup miss. Partial mitigations rolled ~10 days ago; expect p95 improvement ~100ms after next config rollout. Added alert: sustained p95 > 500ms -> page.
Ava - CSM: Draft comms plan: 1) acknowledge incident + timeline 2) steps taken 3) proposed pro-rated credit 4) offer an enablement session to review config and best practices. Any objections?
Sofia - Account Lead: No objections. Legal will need to sign final credit. Also compile evidence bundle: uptime graph, incident timeline, logs, config-diff.
Leo - SRE: evidence files queued: `uptime_90d.png`, `incident-2026-03-10.log`, `config-diff.patch`. I'll attach to the evidence zip.
Ava - CSM: I'll draft the email and the renewal slide with the credit calc. Please review before Monday. Tag me with :eyes: when done.
OpsBot - reminder-bot: Review requested by Ava — due 2026-03-29. :alarm_clock:
